title: The Giant Tube Worms of the Mariana Trench

scenes.text: At 10,900 m depth, scientists filmed the largest tube worms ever seen
These worms can grow over 2 meters long, far bigger than the typical 30‑cm species
scenes.label: OVER 2 METERS LONG

scenes.text: They thrive at temperatures above 350 °C, using chemosynthesis instead of sunlight
scenes.label: THRIVE AT 350°C

scenes.text: The species was named *Riftia pachyptila* II after DNA analysis linked it to known Riftia relatives
scenes.label: NEW RIFTIA SPECIES

scenes.text: Follow for a new science fact every day.

description: Explore three mind‑blowing facts about the newly filmed giant tube worms deep in the Mariana Trench. Follow for daily science!
